input.overview: Choose an Exhibit Hall with one shot, open the Ticket Counter, and shoot its scoop to begin a song. Prepare a Multiball while the song runs, then add it without losing the mode's scoring objective.
input.simpleOverview: Start an Exhibit Hall song at the Ticket Counter, then add a prepared Multiball. Each different song and main Multiball also moves you toward Running With Scissors.
input.summary: Choose an Exhibit Hall with its playfield shot, knock down the Ticket Counter target, and shoot the scoop to start one of that hall's songs. While the song runs, prepare a Multiball and add it when the extra balls help more than they disrupt the song's scoring pattern.

quickInfo.name: Start an Exhibit Hall song
quickInfo.summary: Shoot a hall entrance once, knock down the Ticket Counter target, then shoot the exposed scoop and choose one of that hall's two unplayed songs.

quickInfo.name: VIP Pass
quickInfo.summary: Complete V-I-P and shoot either raised center scoop within 10 seconds to choose any unplayed Exhibit Hall song.

quickInfo.name: Three main Multiballs
quickInfo.summary: Dare to Be Stupid uses Harvey and three hamster-wheel locks. Hardware Store uses 27 side-target items and the Supplies Closet. UHF uses the UHF target and three camera locks.

quickInfo.name: Running With Scissors
quickInfo.summary: Play all ten Exhibit Hall songs, all three main Multiballs, My Bologna, and You Make Me, then shoot the Ticket Counter to begin the speed run.

steps.text: Shoot the safest available Hall entrance once: left ramp for Anthropology, left side loop for Sports & Leisure, upper/right side loop for Crime & Punishment, or a mini-loop entrance for Business & Industry or Health & Medicine.
Knock down the Ticket Counter target, shoot the exposed scoop, and choose one of that Hall's two unplayed songs.

During the song, prepare a Multiball: Harvey and the hamster-wheel locks for Dare to Be Stupid, 27 side-target items and the Supplies Closet for Hardware Store, or the UHF target and camera locks for UHF.
Start the prepared Multiball while the song is running when the extra balls fit its scoring objective. Avoid stray shots in modes that punish a wrong shot or break a streak.
If the Ticket Counter lights to end a song, use it when you want to bank the play and move to another unplayed song.
Play all ten Exhibit Hall songs; completing them is not required.
Play Dare to Be Stupid, Hardware Store, and UHF Multiball.
Play My Bologna and visit all five Halls to qualify You Make Me; complete V-I-P and shoot a raised center scoop to start it.
After all fifteen required features have been played, shoot the Ticket Counter to start Running With Scissors.

playfieldReferences.context: Knock down the Ticket Counter target, shoot the exposed scoop.
playfieldReferences.label: Ticket Counter target and scoop
playfieldReferences.description: The guarded scoop used to start or exit Exhibit Hall songs and to start Running With Scissors.

playfieldReferences.label: Exhibit Hall shots
playfieldReferences.description: The left ramp, side loops, and two mini-loop entrances that select the next Exhibit Hall.

playfieldReferences.label: Supplies Closet scoop
playfieldReferences.description: The scoop that starts Hardware Store Multiball after 27 broken items.

playfieldReferences.label: Lite UHF Lock target
playfieldReferences.description: The standup that lights the next camera lock.

cautions.response: Use the physical starts, but read the display for later balance, timing, or award changes.
